children: Neighborhood Intelligence said its subsidiary Beyond Home Services and F9 Investments mutually terminated their Agreement and Plan of Merger, originally signed on July 23, 2026. The decision, effective September 7, 2026, follows the seller’s determination it could not satisfy certain closing conditions, which both parties viewed as not reasonably foreseeable to be met. The merger agreement permits termination by mutual written consent, and the parties have no further obligations under it. No termination fees were disclosed.
: Seller could not satisfy closing conditions
